title: Vanran Locks In Late-January Steam Demo For Its Colossus-Scale Soulslike - NewsBreak
text:
By Alfredo Robelo ,
10 hours ago
Becuzus has announced a public PC demo for Vanran on Steam, running January 23 through January 30, 2026. The date appears in the official “Demo Release Date” trailer and has been echoed by outlet posts and social embeds that link directly to the Steam page for wishlisting ahead of the download window.
Vanran is a dark-fantasy action RPG built around fast, parry-heavy combat and cinematic encounters with towering, Shadow of the Colossus-scale bosses. The Steam overview frames the story as a slave’s rise to rebellion using a sealed blade, with a progression path that mixes armor hunting, random dungeons, and multiple endings that swing between vengeance and salvation. The listing confirms Becuzus as both developer and publisher and currently marks the project as “Coming soon.”
What the new trailer shows The demo-date trailer focuses on speed and scale. Short cuts jump from high-speed chain movement to tight parry windows, then pull back to stage boss fights against grotesque giants in windswept arenas. Prior gameplay uploads and cinematic teasers reinforce that identity, favoring readable attack telegraphs, big punish windows, and traversal that lets players reposition quickly around massive targets. Together, the footage and store copy present Vanran as a soulslike that prizes aggression and timing as much as cautious chip damage.
Soulslikes live or die on feel. A week-long public slice gives Becuzus the chance to prove that parry timing, invincibility frames, and hit feedback land where veterans expect, while also testing performance across a wide range of PCs. It is also a marketing moment that lines up neatly with the early-year discovery window on Steam, when players are sampling new demos and building wishlists. Community posts and news roundups suggest the studio plans to use the trial to gather combat-balance feedback before moving toward a wider launch.
